included: installed MSLK 1.3.0+cu132 wheel architecture and native ABI
Blackwell FMHA FP16/BF16 D32 exact B29/S361/H12/D32 feasibility
dense FP16/BF16 GEMM and fusion compatibility for K/N 384, 768, 1152 and 2304

installed_wheel.activation_guard: final-migration/environment/activate-sm103.sh exports MSLK_PYTHON_ONLY=1, so the unsupported native image is not loaded in the managed SM103 environment.

fatbin_cuobjdump.conclusion: The wheel has neither an SM103 cubin nor SM103 PTX. An SM100 cubin may be a compatibility oracle only; it is not an architecture-exact B300 artifact and is not a production candidate.

installed_wheel.source_release_matrix: The official MSLK release table lists compiled CUDA architectures 8.0, 9.0a, 10.0a and 12.0a for 1.3.0; it does not list 10.3a.

source_identity.identity_method: Relevant installed Python files were compared byte-for-byte with the tagged source checkout; native dynamic symbols agree with the source instantiation list.

production_source.output: FP16 plus mandatory FP32 LSE tensor allocated through ATen

sample_source_contradiction.actual_d32_guard: run_fwd_32 instantiates its 256x128 kernel only under #ifdef FP8
sample_source_contradiction.fp16_d32_sample_result: No kernel is instantiated in the FP16 sample binary.

exact_b29_contract.sequence_tail: 361 % 128 != 0, so MSLK dispatch requires ResidualMask rather than NoMask

minimum_source_experiment_patch: Relax the Python FwOp minimum/_TEST_K checks for D32.
production_blockers: D32 FP16 is uninstantiated and untested in both the wheel and copied CUTLASS sample.
The API allocates output and LSE through ATen instead of accepting KataGo's caller-owned output.
The kernel always materializes LSE while the retained FA4 path requests no LSE.
There is no standalone AOT C-header/object exporter; normal build output is a Torch-dependent 315 MB shared library.
The wheel is SM100/SM120, not SM103a.

comparison_to_retained_fa4.fa4_output: caller-owned FP16 O with no LSE
comparison_to_retained_fa4.decision: Drop MSLK FMHA as a low-hanging swap. Matching the retained path requires a large port with no concrete reason to beat the already-qualified FA4 kernel.

native_grouped_fp16_bf16.misleading_name_note: Despite the bf16 name, source and wheel dispatch accept at::kHalf and at::kBFloat16.
native_grouped_fp16_bf16.layouts: row-major X[M,K], row-major W[N,K] through the ptr-array transpose mapping, row-major output[M,N]
native_grouped_fp16_bf16.epilogue: overwrite only; no beta/C input, residual, bias, SiLU, SwiGLU or affine fusion

shape_alignment.reason: all are multiples of 128 and satisfy the 128-bit alignment contract

arch10_large_m_heuristic.condition: arch major 10 and total_M > 2048 outside the two Llama-specific shapes

boundary_matrix.shape: three times M10469 K384 N384 with one common X
boundary_matrix.constraint: TensorList can repeat the same X pointer, but the stock path launches three argument-setup kernels and allocates through ATen; stacked API partitions X and cannot reuse it without copying.

boundary_matrix.boundary: single K384/N384, N768, N1152 or N2304 projection
boundary_matrix.constraint: No advantage is established over cuBLAS/CuTe; stock entry still carries Torch allocation and argument setup.
Grouped GEMM emits two tensors but does not fuse SwiGLU; retained no-AB12 kernel already fuses both projections, FP16 round-trip and SwiGLU in one 148-CTA launch.
MSLK grouped epilogue has no C input or beta=1 path.
MSLK silu_mul is a separate Triton launch, not a GEMM epilogue. For T10469 it selects BLOCK_D_INNER=1024 and asserts D % 1024 == 0, so KataGo D1152 and D384 do not satisfy its own wrapper.

triton_grouped.output_dtype: hard-coded BF16 for the ordinary grouped path
triton_grouped.same_x_qkv: unsupported without replicating/partitioning the input rows
triton_grouped.fusion: bias and token scaling only; no residual or SiLU/SwiGLU

bf16_swap.kernel_availability: Native grouped source supports BF16 with FP32 accumulation.
bf16_swap.katago_compatibility: The retained network stores FP16 weights and activations. A BF16 swap requires weight conversion and either per-boundary activation conversion or a whole-network precision migration.
bf16_swap.decision: Not an exact backend swap and not low-hanging.

mixed_input.constraint: The CuTe DSL kernel requires a narrow INT4/INT8 operand with FP16/BF16 as the wider operand; it is outside the allowed precision scope and is not a plain FP16/BF16 GEMM.

small_patch: D32 dispatch plus one fixed-length FP16 ResidualMask instantiation can make an MSLK Torch oracle compile, but does not make it production-usable.
The installed SM100 grouped-QKV TensorList op can serve only as a compatibility oracle if its non-SM103 wheel is explicitly allowed in an isolated subprocess.
large_port: MSLK FMHA D32 to standalone exact-SM103a caller-output/no-LSE C ABI
MSLK grouped GEMM to standalone exact-SM103a C ABI with persistent argument/workspace ownership
any residual, affine, SiLU or SwiGLU epilogue fusion

recommended_one_shot.purpose: Isolated oracle only; do not wire into core until it wins S2 and profiler gates.

exact_contract.rope: not fused; retain the accepted planar Q/K RoPE kernel

recommended_one_shot.argument_ownership: Remove ATen/Torch from the experimental launch wrapper. Allocate problem shapes, pointer arrays, strides and CUTLASS workspace once; update only pointers if required. The timed boundary must contain one grouped GEMM launch and no argument-setup kernels or allocations.

wave_hypothesis.current_projection_grid: 252 CTAs = 126 two-SM clusters; each of Q, K and V rounds to two waves, six waves total
wave_hypothesis.hypothesis: The grouped recipe may replace six rounded cluster waves with four while preserving three FP16 projection boundaries.

falsification_risks: A four-wave 2-SM grouped grid is a longer exclusive interval and may reduce cross-stream overlap, repeating the failure mode of the dropped fused QKV+RoPE candidate.
The MSLK heuristic was tuned by architecture major and LLM shapes, not B29 K384/N384 on SM103.
Porting from the tagged MSLK CUTLASS fork to CUTLASS 4.7 may change builder APIs or resource use.
The raw layout mapping must be proven bitwise against three cublasHgemm calls.
gate_order: CPU compile and C ABI identity audit for exact sm_103a; reject any SM100-only artifact.
Bitwise Q/K/V comparison against the current FP16 projections, including planar order and tail rows.
Isolated S1 and coordinated S2 boundary timing against exactly three current projection calls.
NCU resource proof: actual cluster, shared memory, registers, spills and waves.
Only if isolated S2 wins, one short accumulated B29/S2 NSYS run measuring QKV union and FFN/FA4 overlap.
Only if whole-graph union wins, long and accuracy gates under the normal stage process.
recommended_one_shot.stop_condition: Drop immediately if it does not beat the three-projection S2 boundary or if its longer exclusive interval increases whole-graph union. Do not scan other MSLK dense shapes afterward.

final_decision: MSLK 1.3 supplies no drop-in SM103a backend for the retained FP16 graph. Its FMHA is not a D32 competitor to FA4 without a large port. The only source pattern with a plausible low-cost performance hypothesis is the exact FP16 grouped-QKV recipe above, and it merits at most one isolated/profiler-guided attempt.
